description: This file defines the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting attendance records, with validation rules, permission checks, and handling of punch-in and punch-out actions.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing employee attendance records, supporting listing, creation, update, and deletion operations with validation, permission checks, and punch-in/out handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list attendance records for an employee, with filtering by date range and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new attendance record, typically a punch-in, with overlap validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove attendance records, with permission validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to punch out an employee, updating the record with punch-out details.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves employee number from request attributes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing attendance records.

methods.name: getCommonRequestParams
methods.description: Extracts common request parameters for punch-in/out operations.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Validates if current user can perform punch-in actions.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Validates if current user can perform punch-out actions.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from date/time and timezone offset input.

methods.name: setPunchInAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets punch-in details on an AttendanceRecord object.

methods.name: setPunchOutAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets punch-out details on an AttendanceRecord object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating attendance records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating attendance records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting attendance records.
